cases.sentence: Это ___, который живет во мне, совершает свою работу.
cases.explain: Отец is the grammatical subject of совершает, so it is nominative.
The genitive here expresses possession: the prince of this world.

cases.sentence: Он сможет сделать еще больше, потому что Я возвращаюсь к ___.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Я сделаю все, чего бы вы ни попросили во имя Мое, чтобы Отец был прославлен через ___.
cases.explain: The preposition через (through) governs the accusative case.
The verb оставить (leave someone as something) governs a predicate instrumental.
The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: В доме Моего Отца много комнат.
reading.question: What did Jesus say about his Father's house?
reading.explain: Jesus says, 'In my Father's house are many rooms.'

reading.ru: Фома сказал ему, Господи, мы не знаем, куда ты идешь, как же мы можем знать туда путь?
reading.question: What question did Thomas ask Jesus?
options: How can we know the way if we don't know where you are going?
reading.correct: How can we know the way if we don't know where you are going?
reading.explain: Thomas asked how they could know the way if they did not know where Jesus was going.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил, Я есть путь, истина и жизнь. Никто не приходит к Отцу, как только через Меня.
reading.question: How did Jesus answer Thomas?
options: He said he is the way, the truth, and the life, and no one comes to the Father except through him
He said the way is hidden from everyone
He said Thomas would never understand
He said the disciples must ask the Father directly
reading.correct: He said he is the way, the truth, and the life, and no one comes to the Father except through him
reading.explain: Jesus answered, 'I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.'

reading.ru: Филипп сказал, «Господи, покажи нам отца, и этого нам будет достаточно».
reading.question: What did Philip ask Jesus?
reading.explain: Philip said, 'Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.'

reading.ru: Кто видел меня, тот видел и отца».
reading.question: How did Jesus respond to Philip's request to see the Father?
options: Whoever has seen him has seen the Father
The Father cannot be seen by anyone
Only Moses had seen the Father
reading.correct: Whoever has seen him has seen the Father
reading.explain: Jesus replied, 'Whoever has seen me has seen the Father.'

reading.ru: Я попрошу Отца, и Он даст вам другого заступника, чтобы он навеки остался с вами, Духа Истины.
reading.question: What did Jesus promise to ask the Father to give the disciples?
options: Another Counselor, the Spirit of Truth, to remain with them forever
A visible sign in the sky
reading.correct: Another Counselor, the Spirit of Truth, to remain with them forever
reading.explain: Jesus promised to ask the Father to give them another Counselor, the Spirit of Truth, to remain with them forever.

reading.ru: Я не оставлю вас сиротами, я вернусь к вам.
reading.question: What assurance did Jesus give about not abandoning his disciples?
options: He would not leave them as orphans; he would return to them
He would send someone else forever in his place
He would leave them in the Pharisees' care
He would never speak to them again
reading.correct: He would not leave them as orphans; he would return to them
reading.explain: Jesus said, 'I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.'

reading.ru: Мой мир я даю вам. Я даю вам не так, как дает этот мир.
reading.question: What kind of peace did Jesus say he gives?
options: A peace unlike what the world gives
Peace only for the Jewish people
reading.correct: A peace unlike what the world gives
reading.explain: Jesus says he gives peace, but not as the world gives it.

reading.ru: Но мир должен узнать, что я люблю отца, и что я делаю то, что отец мне повелел. Вставайте. Пойдем отсюда.
reading.question: How does the chapter end?
options: Jesus tells them to get up and go, so the world will know he loves the Father
Jesus falls asleep at the table
reading.correct: Jesus tells them to get up and go, so the world will know he loves the Father
reading.explain: Jesus says the world must know he loves the Father, then tells them, 'Arise, let us go from here.'
